mappings.intent: Find and understand a healthcare service
conditions: Select only the actions the customer actually supports.
Do not display live availability unless connected to a reliable source.
Do not imply a booking is confirmed until the booking system confirms it.
Do not promise access to patient records without a confirmed authorization process.
Do not expose patient-specific information on public pages.

mappings.intent: Understand referral requirements and submit a referral
conditions: Confirm accepted referral types and channels.
Use approved secure channels for patient information.

mappings.intent: Find laboratory procedures, technical resources, or authorized tools
conditions: Verify technical documentation and revision status.
Do not generate unapproved testing or equipment instructions.

mappings.intent: Evaluate a device or request a commercial discussion
conditions: Use only verified product specifications and approved claims.
Confirm regulatory status and intended use for each relevant market.

mappings.intent: Find and apply for a professional opportunity
conditions: Confirm the actual application and credential-verification process.
Explain how submitted personal information will be used.

mappings.intent: Evaluate a vendor, platform, or partnership
conditions: Do not fabricate customer logos, outcomes, or case studies.
Publish security and integration claims only when verified.

generation_rules: Treat page lists as candidates, not mandatory requirements.
Generate the sitemap from confirmed audiences, business goals, services, and required functionality.
Avoid creating a separate page for every persona if shared content serves the same need.
Support multiple journeys when users have different goals.
Separate public informational journeys from authenticated workflows.
Record the reason for each recommended page or feature.
